research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Checkout.com is researching an account linking system that uses a server and user device to extract and analyze a shopper’s purchase history to verify item purchases. The account linking system description shows work on secure data retrieval, linking user accounts across services, and automated verification workflows. Overall, they are developing purchase verification, secure account linkage, and transaction data processing capabilities.

overview_description.description: Checkout.com provides the fastest, most reliable payments in more than 150 currencies, with in-country acquiring, world-class fraud filters and reporting through one API. The company launched in 2012 and now has a team of more than 1700 people across 19 offices worldwide, offering local expertise where it’s needed.

about_short_description.short_description: Checkout.com is a global provider of payment solutions that help businesses and communities thrive in the digital economy.

product.name: Accept Online
product.description: An online payment processing solution for accepting card payments and alternative payment methods across websites, applications, and digital commerce channels.

product.name: Unified Payments API
product.description: A single API for connecting businesses to Checkout.com payment processing, payment methods, platforms, and related money-movement capabilities.

product.name: Acquiring
product.description: Global merchant acquiring services that process payments through local acquiring connections in more than 50 countries and support over 150 processing currencies.

product.name: Payment Methods
product.description: A payment-method service supporting major card schemes, bank transfers, digital wallets, direct debits, vouchers, and local alternative payment methods.

product.name: Intelligent Acceptance
product.description: An AI-based payment optimization service that evaluates transaction signals and payment outcomes to improve acceptance rates and recover otherwise declined revenue.

product.name: Flow
product.description: A customizable checkout solution with configurable payment blocks designed to support faster and more tailored online payment experiences.
